thread.title: Apple's stock chops nearly 40 points off Dow industrials

title: Apple's stock chops nearly 40 points off Dow industrials
text:
Published: Apr 20, 2018 11:17 a.m. ET Share Mark DeCambre 
The Dow Jones Industrial Average late-morning Friday was trading lower for a third straight session, with shares of Apple Inc., exacting the largest toll on the blue-chip gauge. Apple shares AAPL, -4.13% were off 3.4%, or about $5.92, with the magnitude of the drop sapping about 40 points from the Dow DJIA, -1.05% in early action. The Dow most recently was down 230 points, or 0.9%, at 24,438, while the S&P 500 index SPX, -1.07% was off 0.8% at 2,670 and the technology-laden Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -1.45% down 1.1% at 7,158. Apple's decline may be influenced by downbeat forecasts for the iPhone maker amid disappointment over chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing TSM, -1.67% which lowered its revenue guidance range for the second quarter, citing weak demand for cell phones. That has led some Wall Street analysts to speculate that weakness in demand bodes ill for Apple Inc. AAPL, -4.13% Quote References
